communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the North Carolina Public Records Law, I hereby request the following records:

Please provide electronic copies of records maintained by WAKE COUNTY PUBLIC SCHOOL SYSTEM from October 13, 2026 through the date of this request concerning a separate records request that I submitted on October 13, 2026.

I request the following existing records:

1. any records and computer logs that show how you satisfied the search in response to my request

2. all written or electronics records related to your search, including but not limited to which offices, departments or custodians searched for the records; what search terms, keywords or date ranges were used; what systems, databases or physical files were checked; which specific locations or file types were excluded

3. any internal correspondence, including emails or IT tickets, that document your search

4. any search certification, search affidavit or written description of the search methodology

5. any written or electronic communication that contains any of the following terms: "OCR case 11-24-1501," "Office for Civil Rights, "OCR," "11-24-1501," "The Hechinger Report," "Hechinger," "Neal Morton" or "Morton."

If no responsive records exist, please state that explicitly. If any portion is withheld, please identify the specific exemption and release all reasonably segregable portions. Please provide the records electronically and notify me before incurring fees above $25.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Neal Morton
